All-in-One IPTV + Torrents with Privacy, Convenience, and Quality.

**What is IPTV?** Internet Protocol Television gives you instant access to 1000+

**What is TorrServe?** Watch 4K movies instantly via torrent-streaming apps like
Lampa, Prisma TV, Torxy, and more — no need to download.

**Total Privacy.** We provide a private, dedicated server. Your ISP can't track

help? Our specialist can come to your home and handle everything for you.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**1. What is the minimum internet speed for watching channels?**
Our speed recommendations: 10 Mbit/s or more for smooth SD channel viewing;
25 Mbit/s or more for HD channels; 50 Mbit/s or more for the Full HD package;
150 Mbit/s or more for the 4K package (TorrServer).

**2. How many devices can I use simultaneously?**
You can use your subscription on up to two devices at the same time.

**3. What is the channel archive and where can I find it?**
The archive lets you rewatch your favorite shows and movies even if you missed
the live broadcast. Panda TV currently offers a 4-day archive for all channels.
Accessing the archive depends on the player or device you're using.

**4. What playlist formats do you provide?**
Three formats, based on your device or player: M3U8 — the most common format,
compatible with most players and devices; Samsung TV — playlist for the default
Samsung Smart TV player; Enigma Playlist — format for devices running Enigma OS.

**5. How do I add the playlist to my device?**
If your player supports direct playlist URL input, we recommend using that
method for automatic updates. If not, we'll provide the playlist file for manual
upload via USB or FTP.

**6. What payment methods do you accept?**
Bank transfers, Revolut, Telegram Payments, cryptocurrency, and PayPal.

**7. Which countries' channels are available?**
Channels from over 40 countries, including: Australia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Arab
countries, Lithuania, Moldova, Poland, Portugal, Belarus, Brazil, UK, Germany,
Romania, USA, Turkey, Uzbekistan, Georgia, Israel, India, Spain, Ukraine,
Croatia, France, Sweden, Italy, Kazakhstan, Canada, Latvia, Russia, Finland,
Estonia.

**8. Can I use Panda TV while traveling or abroad?**
Yes. You can watch from anywhere in the world as long as you have internet
access. Just make sure your device and player are properly configured.

**9. Is there a free trial available?**
Yes, we offer a free trial so you can test the service before subscribing.
Contact us via Telegram, WhatsApp or e-mail to request one.

**10. What devices are supported?**
Smart TVs, Android boxes, phones, tablets, computers, and even Enigma-based
receivers. If your device supports m3u8 playlists — it works with us.

**11. Is adult content included by default?**
No. Adult content is optional and only activated upon request. We respect
personal preferences and family-friendly viewing.

**12. Can I get a custom playlist with only the channels I want?**
Yes. Our Custom Plan allows you to select specific channels or groups. You
choose exactly what you pay for — no unnecessary extras.

**13. Is TorrServer legal and safe to use?**
We don't promote or host copyrighted content. TorrServer is provided as an
optional tool for users who want more flexibility.

**14. Will my subscription renew automatically?**
No. We don't do auto-renewals. You're in full control of when and how you pay.
However, you can choose to pay for a full year in advance and get a 10%
discount.

**15. What if a channel stops working?**
We monitor streams 24/7. If something goes wrong, report it via Telegram and
we'll fix it quickly or replace the stream.
